time_forward: test 2024 uses all earlier-year rows; test 2025 uses only years <2025; test 2026 uses only years <2026 and is cut at 2026-07-06. Feature results use only same competition-season completed games on dates <= target UTC date minus 3 days.

prior_research_dedup.R44: R44 tested 365/90-day rolling points, goal difference, ranks and recent momentum; this run uses explicit competition-season keys and reconstructs a date-specific table. No rolling-window feature is reused.
prior_research_dedup.R43: R43 tested league-level market response calibration; not repeated.
prior_research_dedup.R46: R46 tested UTC kickoff calendar interactions; not reused.
prior_research_dedup.R49: The already audited 453-team one-to-one team identity bridge is reused as a join only.

coverage.receipt_profit_claim: No contemporaneous receipt-versioned standings snapshots exist in the source. Historical current-table features are not represented as real-time receipt information; do not call this live-receipt ROI.

model_parameters.training: expanding earlier calendar years only; standardize on training rows; keep same test cohort for every model; no target-year tuning.
model_parameters.bet_direction: per fixture choose the side with higher predicted Crown netU; no production gate or candidate threshold.
